# `scripts/post-process/compression12bit.py`

Source: [compression12bit.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/compression12bit.py)

Bit packing of floats and integers (8, 12, 16, 32 or 64 bits), used by `Nbody_Compression`.

`compress_12bit` / `decompress_12bit` quantise floats in [0, max] or [-max, max] to 12 bits
(two values in three bytes). `compress_integer_array` packs integers at a chosen or optimal bit depth
with the values that do not fit stored separately (overflow indices and values).

## Contents

- [`compress_12bit`](#compress_12bit) - compresses values to 12 bit precision and store them in a unint8 array spliting each element in 1.5 element of array if input\_dtype='integer is given then assumes integer and max value is not used for this case if allow\_negative=True then the rand is -2047 - 2047 otherwise 0-4095
- [`decompress_12bit`](#decompress_12bit) - Deccompresses values from 8 bit unint into 15 bit uint combine 1.5 element inot a 12 bit integer if input\_dtype='integer is given then assumes integer and max value is not used for this case if allow\_negative=True then the rand is -2047 - 2047 otherwise 0-4095
- [`compress_integer_array`](#compress_integer_array) - Pack the integer array `arr` (even length) at `bit_depth` bits (chosen by `find_optimal_bit_depth` if None, allowing at most `overflow_threshold` of the values to overflow); values too large for the depth go to an overflow list.
- [`decompress_integer_array`](#decompress_integer_array) - Inverse of `compress_integer_array`: unpack `original_size` values and put the overflow values back.
- [`find_optimal_bit_depth`](#find_optimal_bit_depth) - The bit depth (8, 12, 16, 32, 64) that gives the smallest packed size including the overflow list, among those with an overflow fraction at most `overflow_threshold`; 64 if none qualifies.
- [`calculate_packed_size`](#calculate_packed_size) - Bytes needed for `array_length` values at `bit_depth` bits (12 bits rounded up to whole bytes).
- [`test_12bit_compression`](#test_12bit_compression) - Round-trip test of the 12-bit float compression on `size` random values (signed and unsigned); prints the errors.
- [`test_compression_decompression`](#test_compression_decompression) - Round-trip test of `compress_integer_array` at `bit_depth` with values that overflow it.

## compress_12bit

```python
compress_12bit(data, max_value, allow_negative=True, little_endian=True, input_dtype='float')
```

compresses values to 12 bit precision and store them in a unint8 array spliting each element in 1.5 element of array
if input\_dtype='integer is given then assumes integer and max value is not used for
this case if allow\_negative=True then the rand is -2047 - 2047 otherwise 0-4095

## decompress_12bit

```python
decompress_12bit(compressed, max_value, output_size, allow_negative=True, little_endian=True, input_dtype='float')
```

Deccompresses values from 8 bit unint into 15 bit uint combine 1.5 element inot a 12 bit integer
if input\_dtype='integer is given then assumes integer and max value is not used for
this case if allow\_negative=True then the rand is -2047 - 2047 otherwise 0-4095

## compress_integer_array

```python
compress_integer_array(arr, bit_depth=None, little_endian=True, possible_bit_depth=[8, 12, 16, 32, 64], overflow_threshold=0.0)
```

Pack the integer array `arr` (even length) at `bit_depth` bits (chosen by
`find_optimal_bit_depth` if None, allowing at most `overflow_threshold` of the values to overflow);
values too large for the depth go to an overflow list.

Returns (packed bytes, overflow indices, overflow values, original dtype, bit depth).

## decompress_integer_array

```python
decompress_integer_array(packed, overflow_indices, overflow_values, original_dtype, bit_depth, original_size, little_endian=True)
```

Inverse of `compress_integer_array`: unpack `original_size` values and put the overflow
values back.

## find_optimal_bit_depth

```python
find_optimal_bit_depth(arr, overflow_threshold)
```

The bit depth (8, 12, 16, 32, 64) that gives the smallest packed size including the overflow list,
among those with an overflow fraction at most `overflow_threshold`; 64 if none qualifies.

## calculate_packed_size

```python
calculate_packed_size(array_length, bit_depth)
```

Bytes needed for `array_length` values at `bit_depth` bits (12 bits rounded up to whole bytes).
